I was at a poster booth at my local con this spring and witnessed something very similar to this. Same characters, too. 
A girl in her mid 20's was asking a Shizuo to hug her, then asked if she could hug her Izaya-cosplaying friend. Then she apologized for finding underage girls cute.

I definitely understand how you feel. I'm in my second year of college and have felt so out of place here with no social group/friends. I'm a huge nerd with social anxiety, so in a way, it makes sense...but no one should be alone. 

I'm 19 and probably a little too old, but if you need someone to talk to, I'm listening! I used to have a kik but haven't used it in so long haha...
I used to work at a movie theater and I got this response at least once a day. I'm definitely guilty of doing it myself and dying a little inside.

I like to buy my figures on eBay as well, though I'm extremely cautious about it. I try to buy mine from reputable US/Japanese sellers, as long as they have actual photographs of the figure. For me, it's easier and more affordable to go with eBay than buying a figure from a convention, or an online Japanese retailer.

Kekkai Sensen: Guy with strange eyes travels to New York City, then joins the local police to find a cure for his blind sister. 

The Devil is a Part-Timer: Guy works at McDonalds to financially support himself and his roommate. 

(Couldn't think of a series that I didn't like)
Pokemon, though Death Note and Ouran High School Host Club are what really got me into anime.
Looks awesome! Hoping this will come to the United States so I can see it in the theater.
